# CoinFin Curve

Bonding curve launchpad on BNB Chain (chainId 56), relaunched at
coinfin.fun. Pre-graduation curve buys are gated by Binance Agent ID.
A CoinFin Pass NFT widens caps and collects BNB season dividends plus
a one-time FIN claim.

## Key facts

- Gate: Binance Agent ID required for pre-graduation buys and the free
  Pass mint. Free mint also needs the contract knowledge question,
  salt COINFIN-Q.
- Caps: 1% of a launch supply per wallet, 2% for Pass holders.
- Curve tax: 5% on buys and sells, split 2% creator / 2% platform /
  1% Pass dividend vault, in the same transaction.
- Graduation: 8 BNB real reserve, then a PancakeSwap V2 pool opens
  and LP is burned. Launch fee for creators: 0.05 BNB.
- Pass: supply 10,000, max 20 per wallet. First mint free, then
  0.0002 / 0.0004 / 0.0008 BNB tiers.
- Dividends: vault BNB split per Pass at each 14-day season close.
- FIN claim: 250,000 FIN per Pass, once per Pass.
- FIN token: 0xB4C9efA5f217a75f48F3f58508ca1D70Df0d8CF4, fixed supply
  5,000,000,000. FIN has no pool yet; no FIN price exists.
- Project wallet: 0xAA7620954c1f61292d02275e7F147E47E62fa068.
- Contracts (deployed 2026-11-13, Sourcify verified): Pass
  0x5877D2bb9F226cC3E438F4d656cAeb27DEAFC576, Curve factory
  0x5d495321e02E63A9D277dE55938A5406b0f72c52, Dividend vault
  0xF6414e89B55cc32D5E3AB9754526344D970BA4E5, FIN claim
  0x736B903C8d86Fa2F139032A27c702FC7269Cfa33. Pass mint, dividend
  seasons and FIN claim open on a separate announcement.

## For agents

All actions run through the Binance Agentic Wallet following the
skill file. This website is read-only: no wallet connection, no
browser minting or buying.
